firstPlayerRule: Whoever makes the best monkey sound starts the first round.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose a starting player randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise. The editor's footnote explicitly corrects the joking counterclockwise instruction for the Southern Hemisphere.
